name: Anata o Otoko ni Shite Ageru!
original_name: あなたをオトコにしてあげる！
source:
“The winning couple are destined to be together for all eternity!”

That’s what they say about our school’s couple contest. And I, Toushirou Utsugi, ended up being entered into the contest despite being single. Why?

Because my group, the Wednesday Club, wants to leave proof of our existence in the form of the winner’s trophy that’s displayed in the showcase at the school entrance.

“Want to know the secret to winning the couple contest? Well, just leave it to me! I know more about the contest than anybody else!”
The manager of our club and my childhood friend, Itsuki Futaba, has devised a detailed game plan, one that marks a sudden shift in the Wednesday’s Club daily activities, which have, in the past, been nothing but sitting around daydreaming.

“Okay, let’s hit the ground running! Step one? Strength! Step two? Strength! I don’t have a step three and step four, but as long as you’re with me, we’ll win this for sure!”
The sporty Kogane Ayukawa starts pulling me around by the arm.

“When you really think about it, knowledge and memories are all just thought patterns. Are you up for the test... to see how much you know about me?”
Our intelligent leader, Beniyuki Toomi, stays by my side while she tutors me.

“What you need is some style and personality. And I need you. Understand?”
The infrequent member, Rika Shuukaidou, spends every day ballroom dancing like the young madam she is...

They really think they can win the couple contest by improving me as a man?
Who am I even supposed to pick as my girlfriend in the first place...?!

...We’ll make the best couple!

The crazy romance-comedy of four girls and a guy who are more than just friends starts here!

translation:
“胜出的情侣注定要永远在一起！”

学校情侣大赛就是这样宣传的。可我，宇津木俊四郎，明明单身，却被报名参加了比赛。为什么？

因为我们的社团“星期三俱乐部”想用奖杯证明自己的存在，而奖杯正陈列在学校入口的展示柜里。

“想知道赢得情侣大赛的秘诀吗？交给我吧！没人比我更了解这项比赛！”

社团负责人、我的青梅竹马双叶树月制定了详细计划，让星期三俱乐部的日常活动突然改变。过去，我们只会坐着做白日梦。

“好，马上行动！第一步是力量！第二步还是力量！虽然没有第三步和第四步，但只要你和我在一起，我们一定能赢！”

运动健将鲇川小金拉着我的手臂把我拖走。

“仔细想想，知识和记忆都只是思维模式。你愿意接受测试……看看你对我了解多少吗？”

聪明的领袖远见红雪留在我身边，为我辅导。

“你需要的是风格与个性。而我需要你。明白了吗？”

不常参加活动的朱开堂梨花，每天都像年轻夫人一样跳交际舞……

她们真的以为，只要把我培养成男人，就能赢得情侣大赛吗？
我到底该选谁做女朋友……？！

……我们会成为最佳情侣！

四名女孩和一个男人、超越朋友关系的疯狂恋爱喜剧，就此开始！
